rv.q: A great American classic has been captured with total, transfixing fidelity by this dedicated ensemble.

And for most of these eight hours, we watch a man doing just that.The overlap of fiction on reality is deliberately inexact. But the impact can be unevenSitting down at his desk one morning, a Midwestern office worker finds his computer on the blink and a copy of a great American novel in his in-tray.
